name: Party Profile Information 5
definition: Information to support the Know Your Customer (KYC) processes.

CertificationIndicator.name: Certification Indicator
CertificationIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the certificate type has been obtained and verified.

ValidatingParty.name: Validating Party
ValidatingParty.definition: Identification of the person who validated the document.

CheckingParty.name: Checking Party
CheckingParty.definition: Identification of the person who checked the document.

ResponsibleParty.name: Responsible Party
ResponsibleParty.definition: Identification of the person who is responsible for the document.

CheckingDate.name: Checking Date
CheckingDate.definition: Date at which the certification check has been performed.

CheckingFrequency.name: Checking Frequency
CheckingFrequency.definition: Specifies how frequently the check is performed.

NextRevisionDate.name: Next Revision Date
NextRevisionDate.definition: Specifies the date at which the next certification check will be performed.

SalaryRange.name: Salary Range
SalaryRange.definition: Limits between which a person's salary is estimated.

SourceOfWealth.name: Source Of Wealth
SourceOfWealth.definition: Indicates the main source of revenue.

CustomerConductClassification.name: Customer Conduct Classification
CustomerConductClassification.definition: Specifies an assessment of the customer’s behaviour at the time of the account opening application.

RiskLevel.name: Risk Level
RiskLevel.definition: Specifies the customer’s money laundering risk.

KnowYourCustomerCheckType.name: Know Your Customer Check Type
KnowYourCustomerCheckType.definition: Specifies the type of due diligence checks carried out on the investor or account owner. For definitions of ordinary, simple and enhanced know your customer checks, local market regulations should be consulted.

KnowYourCustomerDatabaseCheck.name: Know Your Customer Database Check
KnowYourCustomerDatabaseCheck.definition: Specifies whether a customer has been checked in a Know Your Customer (KYC) database.
